verification.zh: 本型号适用的Jan2026 Rev1.10手册已逐页核对，安装、指示状态、固件识别和适用示例已补入；曲线不估读，独立指南、证书、CAD和实际固件版本仍需另核。
verification.en: The applicable Jan2026 Rev1.10 sheet has been visually reviewed page by page, including installation, indicators, firmware identification and applicable examples. Curves are not interpolated; standalone guides, certificates, CAD and installed firmware still require separate review.

scope.zh: 另核对PISA11普通系列及CLASS2手册剩余24页，补齐安装/状态/固件编码及型号限定的测量示例。
scope.en: The remaining24pages of the ordinary PISA11 and CLASS2 sheets were reviewed for installation,indicators,firmware codes and model-bound measurement examples.

gaps.item: PISA independent documents and catalog scope
gaps.reason: PISA-M/B/11 primary sheets have full-page visual screening in accumulated blocks; continuous curves are not digitized. Independent user/install guides, approvals/actual certificate validity,CAD and firmware compatibility still require separate reconciliation. Current PULS corpus is not an all-public-product completeness claim.

Both Rev1.10 sheets contain a broken61–70C side-clearance clause and the CLASS2 sheet reuses401/402/403 exceptions. Retain wording/context and request manufacturer confirmation rather than infer missing conditions.
